metadata.title: 3 Reasons Why Tesla Stock Has Trailed the S&P 500 for 5 Years<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla Stock Has Trailed the S&P 500 for 5 Years. There Are 3 Reasons Why.
Tesla stock has given investors incredible highs and lows over the years. Shares surged to a record $498.83 just a few months ago after trading below $220 following President Donald Trump’s Liberation Day tariff announcement in April 2025. All that volatility may be obscuring the fact that Tesla stock has trailed the S&P 500 over the past five years.
